gameDescriptionHtml:
AstroPlanet is a sandbox game where you find yourself in the role of an astronaut whose ship has crashed on a planet with an inhospitable atmosphere. Your task is not only to survive, but also to turn this world into a habitable place.

Any planet is at your disposal! You have damaged your ship and ended up on a planet where the air is unsuitable for breathing. But all is not lost! You will have to use all your skills and intelligence to survive and return to Earth.

Build your base from scratch, discover new technologies, grow food and create unique ecosystems. Can you turn this inhospitable planet into a thriving place to live?

Game Features

  • BASE CONSTRUCTION – Start with the basics — create a base that will be your refuge on this hostile planet. Develop a strategy to protect and develop your base.
  • COLLECTING RESPOURCES – Resources are your everything on this planet. Get them, manage them wisely and use them to terraform the planet and grow food.
  • TERRAFORMING THE PLANET – Turn a disastrous landscape into a picturesque paradise! Explore the environment, interact with the ecosystem of the planet and try to transform it into a green and picturesque area.
  • DANGERS AND CHALLENGES – Besides the fact that you have to fight a hostile environment, there are dangers and secrets hiding on the planet. Solve the puzzles and face the threats to survive.
  • GROWING FOOD – There are no grocery stores on this planet. You will have to grow your own food and take care of your diet to avoid starvation.
